category: checkout / payment processor used by Brazilian and Spanish-language resellers

free_tier.stated: Not a service a user buys. Hotmart charges the seller; the buyer pays the product price, with 'taxas especificas que podem ser aplicadas a compras internacionais e de produtos digitais'.

interface_detail: A hosted checkout that adapts by country and converts currency automatically: 'o checkout da Hotmart faz a conversao automatica do valor do seu produto para a moeda do seu comprador'. The seller chooses which methods to enable per product.
tooling: Browser only, plus subscription and installment products. No client needed.
chaining: Hotmart is the Spanish- and Portuguese-language checkout most likely to be in front of a reseller that also sells to Spain, Mexico or Argentina, because it settles in more than 180 countries and converts the price. It is the payment path a foreigner is most likely to complete without a Brazilian document.

limits.value: method availability is set per product by the seller and varies by buyer country; Pix and boleto are listed as Brazil-only

limits_note: The article states that not all methods reach all buyers: 'cada pais possui taxas especificas que podem ser aplicadas a compras internacionais'.
binding_note: The gate is which methods the seller enabled and which ones the buyer's country allows; a card is the only method that crosses both.

identity_cost.detail: Email plus a card. The global card section asks only for 'numero do cartao, nome do titular, data de vencimento e CVV'.

reliability_note: Installments are charged once by Hotmart and split by the buyer's bank, so a refund does not cancel the installments directly with the issuer: 'Depois da aprovacao, nao e possivel cancelar as parcelas diretamente com a operadora.'
confidence_note: The method inventory, the 180-country reach, the global card fields and the Pix-is-Brazil-only classification were read in Hotmart's own help article, updated 2026-10-19.

evidence.proved: 'mais de 20 metodos de pagamento, alcancando compradores em mais de 180 paises'
'Metodos de pagamento exclusivos do Brasil > Pix', which places Pix on the Brazilian side of the divide
the global card path and the installment caveat: 'nao e possivel cancelar as parcelas diretamente com a operadora'

notes: Recorded as a rail, not as a provider: its role is to answer whether a foreigner can pay a Brazilian or Spanish reseller. The answer is yes by card, in a converted currency, subject to the seller having enabled a global method for that product.
